{{Top|leg}}
'''Zone Nineteen''' was an astrographic area near the border of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. It lay between [[Doornik-319]] and [[Wakiza]]. The designation was used by the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]] for the area during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]] of [[16 ABY/Legends|16]]-[[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].<ref name="SOL">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>
